subject: MdePkg/IndustryStandard: Fix typos in macro and struct
reasons: The changes are identifier renames fixing typos (SUPPOTED -> SUPPORTED, VERISON -> VERSION) in header files
Coccinelle cannot rename macro names or struct type names - it operates on C expressions and statements, not preprocessor definitions or typedef names
The macro renames in Acpi50-61 change the identifier string itself, not its value or usage in code
The struct typedef renames in Acpi64/65/66 are not matchable with SmPL syntax
This is a pure identifier-spelling correction, not a code transformation pattern
